newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece minister confirms tax on interbank deals.
newsitem.headline: Greece minister confirms tax on interbank deals.

text.p: Greece will impose a withholding tax on interbank deals, effective January 1, National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou told reporters.

The rate of the new tax would be decided after discussions with all interested parties, he said. Earlier, finance ministry sources told Reuters the withholding tax would be 15 percent, but Papandoniou declined to confirm this.
Asked if banks will be allowed to offset the new taxes with the corporate tax they pay, Papandoniou replied that they will not be allowed to do so.
But Deputy Finance Minister George Drys said banks would be allowed to offset the new interbank taxes with their corporate taxes. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
